notes.title: VoIP update
notes.notes:
Hi. After a long time the VoIP should now be back in the game. There are still some features missing (mute, active talkers). 

If it works as it should the plan looking forward is to make a roadmap together with the community on where the focus will be. https://discord.com/invite/x7KbXEp

notes.title: Small quality of life update
notes.notes:
Hi, here is another small update.

[list]
[*]Added so the camera now follows the sight when playing as gunner on PC in the Firefly
[*]Indicator is added to the sight to see relative turret rotation
[*]All positions should now have the correct hand models
[*]Voip PTT buttons is now also bound to mouse 4/5 buttons
[/list]

notes.title: Some small tweaks and bugfixes
notes.notes:
Hi! A very small update today.
The hitboxes on the t34 turret has been changed and there has also been a few tweaks on the bounce chance of projectiles. 
The AI on the old map should work now again.

notes.title: Commander map update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36645596/bd88326337db96e5da42a5275be47da9696e4ae9.png[/img]

Changed so the air support is now called on the map. 
Commanders can now also ping on the map or set markers. The unused slot will be for artillery in a coming update. 

Work has started on the hands but needs more work on skinning, animations and shading.

notes.title: Small update with controls and VOIP debug
notes.notes:
Hi. You no longer need to look at the steam page for controls. You can now take a look at them before you start playing. 

I am working on getting the VOPI fixed and I have added some extra debug information for that. 
It is a slow process but I have some leads to what the issue is.

Cheers!
/Magnus
